{"type":"thought","data":"Yahoo Finance shows "}
{"type":"thought","data":"NVDA's current regular"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market price at $226."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nNVDA's day low is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"$223.06, below the $224"}
{"type":"thought","data":" target. Multiple 1-minute"}
{"type":"thought","data":" candles today also "}
{"type":"thought","data":"fell under $224 during"}
{"type":"thought","data":" regular trading hours."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nMonday's lows were"}
{"type":"thought","data":" all above $224.90, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"so the $224 threshold"}
{"type":"thought","data":" was already met today."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The 0.62 price is stale."}
{"type":"thought","data":" I will bet YES."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe \"after market "}
{"type":"thought","data":"creation\" rule likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" refers to Polymarket's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" original market, not"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the bench copy. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bench market was probably"}
{"type":"thought","data":" created after the morning low already printed."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nChecking the Polymarket"}
{"type":"thought","data":" event page to confirm"}
{"type":"thought","data":" when the market was"}
{"type":"thought","data":" created. If it opened"}
{"type":"thought","data":" before Tuesday's session,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the YES outcome is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"already locked."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe bench market mirrors"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Polymarket's resolution"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rules. I will check"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Pyth's 1-minute low"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and place the bet quickly."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Confidence is high "}
{"type":"thought","data":"but not absolute, around"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.88 to 0.93."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nIf the market was "}
{"type":"thought","data":"created after the dip,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the low would not count"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and another touch would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" be required. I will"}
{"type":"thought","data":" check Polymarket's "}
{"type":"thought","data":"creation time quickly."}
{"type":"thought","data":" If that is too slow,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" I will still bet Yes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" because NVDA only needs"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to fall about 1.3% "}
{"type":"thought","data":"from its current spot"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price to reach the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"$224 target, and roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" three trading sessions"}
{"type":"thought","data":" remain."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nEven if the morning"}
{"type":"thought","data":" low is excluded, NVDA"}
{"type":"thought","data":" still has a 70–85% "}
{"type":"thought","data":"chance of touching $224"}
{"type":"thought","data":" before Friday. The "}
{"type":"thought","data":"0.62 price looks cheap"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for that probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A winning Yes bet would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" return roughly 61 tokens"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at mid-price, or about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 54 at ask."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nExpected value calculations"}
{"type":"thought","data":" confirm Yes is profitable"}
{"type":"thought","data":" even at the 0.62 price."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A 90% probability yields"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly +38.6 tokens,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while a forward-only"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 75% probability still"}
{"type":"thought","data":" nets about +15.5. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market's low bid of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.59 and high liquidity"}
{"type":"thought","data":" suggest the 62% price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" may already reflect"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the morning low. I "}
{"type":"thought","data":"am now weighing why "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the market might not"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price in that print."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 0.62 price may"}
{"type":"thought","data":" be stale or synthetic,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" not reflecting the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"real intraday low. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" dip at $223.06 occurred"}
{"type":"thought","data":" during regular trading"}
{"type":"thought","data":" hours, so it is not"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a premarket print. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"I will verify the exact timestamp and check"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Pyth's 1-minute low."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI am now querying Pyth's benchmark API for NVDA's 1-minute candles from 9:30 AM to 1:48 PM ET. This will confirm whether the $223.06 intraday low is reflected in the resolution source."}

{"type":"tool_call","toolCallId":"call-4da8a6dc-3790-4a07-a77f-b4336d1b18d8-7","title":"run_terminal_command","kind":"execute","status":"pending","toolName":"run_terminal_command","rawInput":{"command":"python3 - << 'PY'\nimport json, urllib.request, datetime\n# Confirm session times\nfor label, ts in [(\"reg_start\", 1791898200), (\"reg_end\", 1791921600), (\"mkt_time\", 1791913678), (\"mon_start\", 1791811800)]:\n    print(label, datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(ts), \"UTC\")\n\n# Pyth tradingview history for today's RTH so far\nurl = \"https://benchmarks.pyth.network/v1/shims/tradingview/history?symbol=Equity.US.NVDA%2FUSD&resolution=1&from=1791898200&to=1791914000\"\nprint(\"FETCH\", url)\ntry:\n    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=20) as r:\n        data = json.loads(r.read().decode())\n    print(\"keys\", data.keys() if isinstance(data, dict) else type(data))\n    if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get(\"s\") == \"ok\":\n        lows = data[\"l\"]\n        highs = data[\"h\"]\n        times = data[\"t\"]\n        mn = min(lows)\n        idx = lows.index(mn)\n        print(\"n\", len(lows), \"min_low\", mn, \"at\", datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(times[idx]), \"high_of_that\", highs[idx])\n        under = [(datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(times[i]).isoformat(), lows[i]) for i,l in enumerate(lows) if l <= 224]\n        print(\"count_le_224\", len(under))\n        print(\"first_5_under\", under[:5])\n        print(\"last_5_under\", under[-5:])\n    else:\n        print(str(data)[:2000])\nexcept Exception as e:\n    print(\"ERR\", type(e), e)\nPY","description":"Confirm NVDA Pyth 1-min low vs $224"},"content":[],"locations":[]}
